an7.15:1.1: sattime bhikkhave udakupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an7.15:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hoti
an7.15:1.4: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati
an7.15:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti
an7.15:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi
an7.15:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patarati
an7.15:1.8: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti
an7.15:1.9: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an7.15:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hoti
an7.15:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi
an7.15:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hoti.
an7.15:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sādhu hirī
an7.15:3.6: tassa sā saddhā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva tassa sā hirī
an7.15:3.9: tassa sā paññā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyatiyeva
an7.15:3.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati.
an7.15:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti
an7.15:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sādhu hirī
an7.15:4.6: tassa sā saddhā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti
an7.15:4.10: tassa sā paññā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhitā hoti
an7.15:4.11: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti.
an7.15:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi
an7.15:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sādhu hirī
an7.15:5.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano
an7.15:5.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi.
an7.15:6.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sādhu hirī
an7.15:6.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an7.15:6.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patarati.
an7.15:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti
an7.15:7.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sādhu hirī
an7.15:7.6: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
an7.15:7.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti.
an7.15:8.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo
an7.15:8.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu sādhu hirī
an7.15:8.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an7.15:8.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an7.15:9.1: ime kho bhikkhave satta udakupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
